description:
A man who came home as his mother's lover because he was 'X-lal, X-new eyes'. I've seen my mother's lover a lot, but he was especially different from other men. And the day my mother died, I became that man's X-ray.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/X_eye), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/xeye), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/372015656), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12756245), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000068172)
